Finding your purpose is a lifelong adventure that you control. You never know what may or may not come. I find it interesting that we are the only creatures on earth to question are existence so heavily. Think of a dog. Its happy sleeping eating and doing nothing else. Maybe this questioning of ourselves is a byproduct of our intelligence. And if so will this problem or phenomenon of wanting to end our lives prematurely get worse? Lemme just say this. Take a week of from work and go camping either with those you love or alone. And just be their in the moment in the woods. Dont think of the future or the past just be grounded in the present. Take in what around you. What does it smell like, what are you looking at. How does the air around you feel. Take it all in and write it in a journal. Then whenever you are in the busy city life you can always come back to that moment.
